

```{r}

ANALYTE<- "Phosphorus"
VALUE_CAP<- 5


library(tidyverse)
library(here)

data<- read_csv(here::here("data", "cleaned_data_long.csv"))

# assign season levels
season_levels <- c("winter", "spring", "summer", "fall")

assign_season <- function(month) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    month %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "winter",
    month %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "spring",
    month %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "summer",
    month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "fall"
  )
}


data<- data |> 
    dplyr::filter(characteristic == ANALYTE & measure_value < VALUE_CAP) |> 
      dplyr::mutate(
    date_time = as.POSIXct(date_time),
    date      = lubridate::as_date(date_time),
    year      = lubridate::year(date_time),
    doy       = lubridate::yday(date_time),
    season    = factor(assign_season(month), levels = season_levels),
    below_mdl = dplyr::if_else(measure_value < mdl, 1, 0)
  )



```


# ggplot themes and labels

```{r}

# make a universial ggplot theme
ggtheme<- theme_bw()+
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())


# set labels for for the sites
site_labs <- c("center_hill" = "Center Hill",
                "dale_hollow" = "Dale Hollow",
                "percy_priest" = "Percy Priest")

```



# Plotting data by season

```{r}

# make season count df
season_count<- data |> 
    dplyr::group_by(season, site) |> 
    dplyr::count() |> 
    dplyr::ungroup()

# make the plot
season_count |>
    ggplot(aes(x=season, y=n))+
    geom_col()+
    ggtheme+
    facet_wrap(~site, labeller = as_labeller(site_labs))+
    labs(x='Season',
        y="Count")


# =====================================================================
# Year x season x reservoir coverage
# Is the SEASONAL COMPOSITION of sampling stable across years?
# Pooled counts hide drift. Drift here aliases into any s(date) trend.
# =====================================================================
coverage <- data %>%
  dplyr::count(site, year, season, name = "Count") %>%
  tidyr::complete(site, year, season, fill = list(Count = 0))

# Raw counts as a labelled tile grid.
p1_counts <- ggplot(coverage, aes(year, season, fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey90") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), size = 2.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, labeller = as_labeller(site_labs)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1) +
  labs(title = "Sample count by year by season", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "n") +
  ggtheme

print(p1_counts)

# for the data we have, see what the proportion of records were recorded in which season
p1_comp <- coverage %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  mutate(prop = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, prop, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, labeller = as_labeller(site_labs)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", end = 0.9) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal composition of sampling, within year",
       x = NULL, y = "Proportion of samples", fill = "Season") +
  ggtheme

print(p1_comp)


# =====================================================================
# (2) Censoring rate by season x reservoir, plus MDL over time
# Confirm whether the unsampled season is also the least-censored
# regime, and rule out a drifting detection limit masquerading as trend.

# This one is a lot less useful for TP due to the lack of MDL info

# =====================================================================
cens_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(site, season) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    n_cens   = sum(below_mdl, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_cens = round(100 * n_cens / n, 1),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, season)

print(cens_summary, n = Inf)

# Censoring by year, to separate environmental from lab drift.
cens_by_year <- data %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(pct_cens = round(100 * mean(below_mdl, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

p2_cens <- ggplot(cens_by_year, aes(year, pct_cens, color = site)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Percent below MDL by year", x = NULL, y = "% censored") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

# Distinct detection limits and the windows they apply to.
# Look for: MDL steps that line up with changes in pct_cens.
mdl_windows <- data %>%
  group_by(mdl, date) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mdl, date)

print(mdl_windows)

p2_mdl <- ggplot(data, aes(date, mdl, color = site)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Detection limit over time", x = NULL, y = "MDL") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

print(p2_cens)
print(p2_mdl)



```

# Density plots

```{r}
# Density of measure_value, optionally on the log scale.
plot_density <- function(data, log_scale = FALSE, facet_var = NULL) {

  d <- data |>
    mutate(
      .x = if (log_scale) log(measure_value) else measure_value
    )

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(.x)) +
    geom_density(fill = "grey85", color = "grey30") +
    theme_bw()

  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(vars(.data[[facet_var]]), labeller = as_labeller(site_labs))
  }

  p
}


# Distribution: raw is right-skewed (gamma-like)...
plot_density(data, log = FALSE)+
    labs(y="Density")+
    ggtheme

# ...log-transformed is closer to normal (residuals are what matter).
plot_density(data, log = TRUE)


# density by site
plot_density(data, log = FALSE, facet_var = "site")+
    ggtheme+
    labs(x= expression(TP~mg~L^{-1}),
        y="Density")


```
